messages.content:
You are a financial analyst writing a one-paragraph executive summary.

Summarize the following financial report extract in exactly 3 sentences.
Sentence 1: State the revenue and revenue growth.
Sentence 2: State net income and the key expense driver.
Sentence 3: Comment on cash position and headcount change.

Use professional financial language. Do not add analysis not present in the data.

The Q2 revenue for Quillmark Software was $4.2M, up 18% year-over-year. Operating expenses were $3.1M, driven primarily by R&D ($1.8M) and sales and marketing ($0.9M). Net income was $1.1M, compared to $0.6M in Q2 of last year. Cash on hand is $6.4M. Headcount grew from 42 to 51.

response.content: Quillmark Software generated Q2 revenue of $4.2 million, up 18% year over year. Net income was $1.1 million, compared with $0.6 million in Q2 last year, while operating expenses were $3.1 million, driven primarily by R&D spending of $1.8 million. Cash on hand was $6.4 million, and headcount increased from 42 to 51.
